Background

Booker was mayor of Newark before winning a Senate seat in 2013, and he ran for the Democratic presidential nomination in 2020. He won re-election to a third full term on November 3, 2026.

Outlook

Up one point. Booker made his fourth South Carolina trip of the year, keynoting the Charleston NAACP gala and visiting Mother Emanuel, and told reporters afterward he is giving a run a lot of thought. South Carolina votes first, and he starts with more than $20 million in his federal campaign account. His 2020 campaign ended before the first votes, and prediction markets give him under 1 percent.

Recent Headlines

  • Booker told the Charleston NAACP's Freedom Fund Gala that a blue wave is not enough and called for an American change, on his fourth trip to South Carolina this year. Post and Courier via Yahoo News, Nov 21, 2026
  • Booker said in Denver that he is giving a 2028 campaign serious thought while focusing on what he calls an American renewal. Fox News, Nov 14, 2026
  • The Associated Press reported that Booker begins the 2028 cycle with more than $20 million in his federal campaign account after an election-night speech that left little doubt about his ambitions. Associated Press via WHYY, Nov 5, 2026
